subject: 城门守舍
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate exactly ONE isolated game building sprite for tianshu default, Ming dynasty northern Chinese prefectural city architectural kit, original anonymous composite, not a reconstruction of a named monument. Realistic ancient Chinese architecture, same natural material realism and detail density as the attached Song stable reference; reference is style ONLY, change architecture to northern Ming gray brick and gray clay tile, modest timber, restrained hard-gable yingshan roof with straight compact eaves. Orthographic 2:1 dimetric projection, yaw 45 degrees, pitch 30 degrees, NO perspective convergence. East ground axis projects down-right at slope +0.5; north ground axis up-right at slope -0.5; vertical posts stay vertical. Thin almost-flat footprint pad with clearly visible left, front, right corners, not a pedestal. Footprint proportions refer to ground axes, NOT canvas proportions. Main light from SCREEN UPPER LEFT; short soft contact shadow toward lower right. Entire object and base uncut, generous transparent margins. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background, no opaque background or painted checkerboard. No people, animals, writing, pseudo-glyphs, signs, numbers, modern objects, palace ornament on common buildings, Qing imperial decoration, fantasy, neighboring buildings, sky, water, scenery, thick diorama plinth, broad shadows, tilt shift, toy plastic, cropping. Asset bld_kit_ming_north_guardhouse. One small 6 by 5 metre city-gate guard lodging. This is a plain ground-level barrack/sentry-house, NOT a city gate, not a tower, not a fortified gateway. Compact single-storey gray brick structure under one simple northern yingshan gray-tile roof; wooden entrance door faces lower-left, one square wooden lattice side window. Small spear rack beside the entrance under the eave, no guards or flags. Thin gray brick flat ground pad; axes ratio precisely 6:5. Clear visible base corners, no protruding stairs beyond the pad, base slopes +0.5/-0.5. No battlements, arch passage or decorative finials.

references.role: 仅材质、细节密度和写实程度，屋顶年代与视角须服从本prompt

rejected_reason: 首图透明边出现半透明光晕/异常边缘；底面几何与硬山轮廓进一步修正。
